added_independent_interface.status: independent local proof design; not published and not verified by Anderson or Song
added_independent_interface.contract: Finite-interval nonexplosive Markov diffusion; square uniformly nonsingular sigma; positive smooth transition q(s,x;t,y) and marginal p_t(y) solving the forward equation; Chapman–Kolmogorov; semigroup differentiability and decay/integrability sufficient for kernel/generator calculations; reversed kernel K_{u,v}(y,dx)=p_{T-v}(x)q(T-v,x;T-u,y)dx/p_{T-u}(y); reverse generator p_{T-u}^{-1}(L_{T-u}^*(p_{T-u}phi)-phi L_{T-u}^*p_{T-u}) for phi∈C_c^∞; well-posed nonexplosive reverse martingale problem; Brownian reconstruction from the martingale part using sigma^{-1} and Levy characterization. Drift is -b+div(a)+a∇log p with div(a)_i=Σ_j∂_j a_ij.
proof_steps_required: Show the reverse kernel is normalized using the forward marginal identity.
Show reverse Chapman–Kolmogorov by integrating the two forward transition densities and applying their Chapman–Kolmogorov identity.
Differentiate the reverse semigroup on C_c^∞ under exact time/space domination and expand the adjoint generator.
Prove the reversed process solves the localized martingale problem; establish uniqueness/well-posedness and nonexplosion under the stated coefficients.
Reconstruct a Brownian driver by the inverse diffusion matrix and verify it is Brownian (Lévy characterization).
Prove any epsilon-to-zero endpoint weak limit separately.
